title.from: Launch the design partner's three sites as shared-tier tenants once M7 is done
title.to: Design partner's three sites: go live after M7, first as dedicated sites, then move to the shared tier

description.from:
Outcome: Ryan (2026-11-08, correction): the design partner's three new sites launch on the SHARED tier after M7; there is no dedicated launch beforehand. Their launch date is therefore the M7 date, which is why the critical-path plan (PPY-e38a2d) exists. Readiness checklist (M7's exit criteria, all true on production before the first partner site is created): (1) isolation enforced on the shared stack and the adversarial suite green on the release (PPY-bdc4ee, PPY-f7ce77) with security gate 1 signed off (PPY-3ff465); (2) Threat Intelligence cut over to the shared stack and serving correctly (PPY-e51189); (3) a site is created by a data change only: Prospectus deployment created by API (PPY-966ef5), Papyrus provisioning workflow (PPY-70a429), starter template (PPY-3aa10f); (4) provisioning security review passed (PPY-1da916); (5) shared sign-in works with the shared Google client on newsroom.p.apyr.us (PPY-fdbbd7); (6) each site reachable at <site>.p.apyr.us, and at its custom domain if the partner brings one (PPY-82de58, PPY-966722); (7) lifecycle events and the read-only rule wired (PPY-6cb44b, PPY-d7274f); export and deletion work (PPY-e882ee, PPY-62f10d); (8) metering and spend ceilings live, with the partner's usage attributed per site through cost accounting (PPY-3fd951, PPY-889ab5, PPY-49d059, PPY-25e0d7); (9) runbooks rehearsed (PPY-7438d9). Then: create the partner's Account and three deployments, the partner's admins sign in, onboarding, launch.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): Prospectus Account and three deployments (data), Tenant/TenantDomain rows via provisioning, the partner's DNS for custom domains if any.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-provisioning.feature (the paid sign-up scenario, run for each partner site)):
Scenario: A partner site goes live by a data change only
    Given every item of the readiness checklist is done on production
    When the partner's deployment "<site>" is created in Prospectus
    Then the site is provisioned, its admins sign in with Google on newsroom.p.apyr.us, and it serves at <site>.p.apyr.us with no code change or deploy

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-25e0d7. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-259a3f.

Testing: The readiness checklist with evidence on this issue; the provisioning scenario per site.
Rollout: After M7, one site first, then the other two.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: schedule pressure tempts launching before isolation is proven. Mitigation: the checklist is the gate; the critical-path plan is where time is saved, never the gate.

Releasable on its own: not applicable (launch).
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
description.to:
Outcome: As briefed 2026-11-08: the design partner's three new sites launch after M7, first as dedicated sites, and move to the shared tier afterwards. They are also the outside test of Prospectus cost accounting (PPY-25e0d7). The board carried a conflicting, unexecuted draft ("shared tier at M7, no dedicated launch"), so decision D1 in the design note asks Ryan to confirm; the path to M7 (PPY-e38a2d) is the same either way.

Plan of record:
1. Dedicated launch: each site gets today's per-site Prospectus registry entry (accounts/papyrus-sites.json, which Prospectus keeps for dedicated sites; kanbus-b770c2) and its own Papyrus backend; every resource tagged with anthus:app=papyrus, anthus:account=<partner Account UUID>, anthus:deployment=<site id> through the Prospectus @anthus/cost-accounting package; model tokens reported through the usage sender from day one. Note for D1: a dedicated launch does not technically need M7, so it could happen earlier.
2. Move to the shared tier once the readiness checklist below is true on production, one site first, then the other two, reusing the TI runbook (copy-backend --stamp-tenant PPY-8f9462, rehearsal, alias switch, 14-day rollback).

Readiness checklist for the move (M7's exit criteria): (1) isolation enforced, adversarial suite green on the release (PPY-bdc4ee, PPY-f7ce77), gate 1 signed off (PPY-3ff465); (2) TI cut over and serving correctly (PPY-e51189); (3) a site is created by a data change only: Prospectus deployment records by API (kanbus-271b4a; Papyrus side PPY-966ef5), provisioning PPY-70a429, starter template PPY-3aa10f; (4) both provisioning security reviews passed (PPY-1da916, Prospectus kanbus-fa72e8); (5) shared sign-in with the shared Google client on newsroom.p.apyr.us, token bound to the deployment (PPY-fdbbd7, kanbus-3e5e82); (6) each site reachable at <site>.p.apyr.us and at a custom domain if the partner brings one (PPY-82de58, PPY-966722, kanbus-6daa8f); (7) lifecycle and read-only rule wired (PPY-6cb44b, PPY-d7274f), export and deletion work (PPY-e882ee, PPY-62f10d); (8) metering and spend ceilings live, usage attributed per site (PPY-3fd951, PPY-889ab5, PPY-49d059, PPY-25e0d7); (9) runbooks rehearsed (PPY-7438d9).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-provisioning.feature and features_backend/cost-accounting-reports.feature, run for each partner site):
Scenario: A partner's dedicated site reports its cost from day one
    Given a partner site launched as a dedicated site with its Account UUID and deployment id
    When it has served and run model work for a day
    Then the Prospectus ledger shows that day's cost for app papyrus, that Account and that deployment, and no resource is untagged

Scenario: A partner site moves to the shared tier without losing anything
    Given every item of the readiness checklist is done on production
    When the site is copied into its shared-tier tenant and its hostname switched
    Then every URL answers as before, its admins sign in with Google on newsroom.p.apyr.us, and the copy's second run changes nothing

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-25e0d7 and M7 (PPY-dad077) for the move. Implements or extends: PPY-259a3f.

Testing: cost ledger compared with Cost Explorer for one partner site for a week; URL parity check at the move.
Rollout: dedicated launch per site; move one site first, then two.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: schedule pressure to skip the checklist. Mitigation: the checklist is the gate; time is saved on the critical path, never on the gate.

Releasable on its own: not applicable (launch).
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
